cohort: 1527 pregnant women without known thyroid disease or anti-thyroid antibodies.
finding: Variations in TSH levels in early pregnancy up to 4.0 mIU/L in women without thyroid dysfunction were not significantly associated with most fetomaternal outcomes, except for an association between TSH 2.0-4.0 mIU/L and gestational diabetes in primigravid women and higher mean arterial blood pressure in multiparous women.
birth_weight: Mentioned as an outcome for term and preterm deliveries
